about: Project Story: the story layer's own data. flags: every story flag the game keeps in saveData.story, and what it means. patterns: flags made from an id. kept: the story's own records in the same object (not flags). speakers: the names a script may write before a line, and whose portrait and name they stand for. quests: each quest's stages in order. presets: start points for ?story=name (test runs only): place, story flags, trainers beaten (with their badges), pyramids, items, team.

flags.rival0: how Blake's first battle went: win, lose or skip (story.js storyAfterRival; read by scripts.blake-first-battle)
flags.firstLoss: RL-S1: the first lost run's scene has played (story.json scripts.back-lost); later losses get a picked pair (banter.json back_lost)
flags.ending: the last clue: the story's last stage (story.js storyEnding, lore.js loreStage)
flags.ch1_drop: RL-S2: Chapter 1's first beat said (banter.json ch1_drop, Hazel: you keep falling, on a schedule)
flags.ch1_blake: RL-S2: Chapter 1's second beat said (banter.json ch1_blake, Chosen on Blake)
flags.ch1_beans: RL-S2: Chapter 1's third beat said (banter.json ch1_beans, Hazel on the Bureau's Beans)
flags.ch1_number: RL-S2: Chapter 1's fourth beat said (banter.json ch1_number, Hazel found your number on their forms)
flags.ch1_signal: RL-S2: Chapter 1's fifth beat said (banter.json ch1_signal, Chosen: something big on Hazel's instruments); the sixth is scripts.chapter1-end, after the Voltron (RL-14)
flags.clueLanyard: the lanyard clue found (lore.json clues: lanyard)
flags.clueVoice: the voicemail clue found (lore.json clues: voicemail)
flags.metCass: Cass recognised you: the face clue (lore.json clues: face)
flags.planKnown: unlocks lore entries (lore.json); set nowhere yet
flags.metVariants: unlocks lore entries (lore.json); set nowhere yet
flags.region:crystal: unlocks lore entries (lore.json); set nowhere yet
flags.region:goldenhills: unlocks lore entries (lore.json); set nowhere yet
flags.region:meadowlands: unlocks lore entries (lore.json); set nowhere yet
flags.region:sporeforest: unlocks lore entries (lore.json); set nowhere yet

patterns.met_<id>: met a person, or a trainer who runs up to you (their script sets it)
patterns.legend_<species>: the day a legend was last met, so once a day (story.js legendCheck)
patterns.clue_<clue>: a clue found, for a clue whose unlock isn't a flag (lore.js loreClue)

kept.talks: times you have talked to each person (conditions: visits:person)
kept.once: the once blocks and [once] options already played
kept.cycles: where each cycle and seq is
kept.resume: a script saved halfway: which one, and where it goes on from
kept.said: RL-S1: the story director's lines said (banter.json id: the runs ended when it was said; logic/story-pick.js)
kept.fresh: RL-S1: each hub character's line picked on the way home, said at the first talk after it (who: banter.json id)
kept.pending: RL-S1: a scene to play on arriving home (back-lost after a lost run), kept until it has played

chapter1-end.about: RL-S2: Chapter 1's last beat, after the Voltron is beaten (RL-14 calls it: storyState.pending = 'chapter1-end', as back-lost); it moves the story on to chapter 2

chosen.about: Professor Chosen in his lab (talk.js talkChosen): your Index, your badges, where Blake went

if caught >= 15

elif caught >= 5
[surprised] You’re getting good at this. Not chosen good. But good. Some of them only show up in caves or in the malls. #l:251a

1 badge already. The arena leaders talk about you. Not as much as about me. But they talk. #l:4eb4

blake-first-battle.about: after Blake’s first battle in the opening, won, lost or skipped (rival0): Blake has his say, the Chosen heals your team and points you down the road (story.js storyAfterRival)
script: if rival0 = win
[surprised] Blake: What? I lost to someone who fell out of the sky an hour ago? #l:0008
[angry] Blake: Mine only knows Tackle. That’s my excuse and I’m sticking to it. #l:4d19
elif rival0 = lose
[happy] Blake: Ha! Told you. Mine beats yours. #l:5707
Blake: Don’t feel bad. You only got here today. #l:b848
if rival0 = win or rival0 = lose
Blake: I’m off to train on the golf course. Next time I’ll have a whole team. Try to keep up! #l:2d35
heal
[happy] There. Good as new. I have healing hands. Hazel has a first-aid kit. Same thing. #l:256f
Granny Juniper made up a room for you in her cottage, by the hives. Every hero needs a base. #l:68e0
Now go and explore! The road teaches more than any book. I’ve read zero books, and look at me. #l:36c7

ending.about: after you beat Vinylla at the Inner Sun: what everyone says before the last clue (story.js storyEnding)
script: [sad] Vinylla: Gold. Everywhere. On the floor, on the press, on the record... #l:82ed
[happy] Aurumansa. The golden caravan. I foresaw this. I didn’t write it down, but I foresaw it. #l:8b79
Look at it, Vinylla. Gold all over the pressing floor. Nothing here is limited any more. #l:3e56
[angry] Vinylla: Do you know what a record is worth if everyone can have one? #l:960e
[happy] Blake: About what it’s worth to listen to it. Turns out that was the point. #l:d97e
And you. You were the sound engineer on her tour. You read the plans, and Cass made sure you fell. #l:ac5c
[happy] Welcome back. The sun is still up. It will be up tomorrow too. #l:299a

after-opening.about: Blake's first battle won, in Copperleaf, before anyone else is met
